name: Babruvahana
reason: Meaning was only a relationship description; gave a literal gloss.

fix.meaning_en: One with tawny (brown) steeds or vehicle; Arjuna's son of Manipur (etymology of babhru-vāhana, uncertain in detail)

name: Dhrishtadyumna
reason: Pandava commander, Draupadi's brother; correct parts dhṛṣṭa (bold) + dyumna (splendour).

name: Jambavan
reason: Meaning was a title, not a meaning of the name.

fix.meaning_en: Wise and mighty bear-king of the Ramayana, ally of Rama (name from Jambavat; etymology uncertain)

name: Janamejaya
reason: Epic king, Parikshit's son; traditional gloss acceptable, though nuance uncertain.

name: Mandhata
reason: iast field was the stem form, not the spoken name.

fix.meaning_en: Great Ikshvaku emperor of the Puranas; etymology uncertain

name: Pururavas
reason: Spoken Hindi form is Pururava; Devanagari had a halant-less stem form and meaning was only a lineage note.

fix.name: Pururava
fix.meaning_en: Very renowned or loud-crying (puru 'much' + rava 'cry, fame'); etymology uncertain
